rows.en: Xiujian: "..."
Touya: "Xiujian..."
Xiujian: "...I'm sorry. Would you leave me alone...?"
Touya: "Xiujian, let me..."
Clovis: "For now... leave him be.
He's not that fragile. Besides,
what we have to do is rescue Ymir."
Touya: "I know that..."
Celica: "...Anyway, let's hurry after them!
Baren, please."
Baren: "Understood. Liebhofen, full speed ahead!"
Celica: "We're nearly there!"
Sisk: "I've found it! What? Is that... a rocket?"
Celica: "They got us... It's a decoy...
There's still time! Let's go to the next one!"
Celica: "Oh, it stopped!"
Touya: "Has it landed?"
Sisk: "But it's still well short of the garrison."
Celica: "Could it be...?"
Sisk: "I've found it! Oh..."
Celica: "A decoy rocket...
There's still time! Let's go to the next one!"
Celica: "We're nearly there!"
Sisk: "I've found it! Is that... a rocket?"
Celica: "They got us... It's a decoy...
There's still time! Let's go to the next one!"
Celica: "N-Not bad... To think they were all decoys..."
Clovis: "Tch, so the information we were given
wasn't the whole story."
Touya: "Hey, don't we have any other leads?"
Celica: "We've lost them completely..."
Arthur: "So there's nothing we can do...?"
Maki: "Hey, haven't you forgotten about me?"
Fain: "Maki!"
Maki: "You know how far my information network reaches, Fain-chan,
don't you?"
Fain: "That's true, but... it won't be free, will it?
I can't imagine you working for free, Maki... Ow, ow, ow!"
Maki: "Is this the mouth saying such cheeky things?"
Touya: "Hey, can you really find them?"
Maki: "Of course! In fact, I've already looked into it."
Celica: "What?! Where?"
Maki: "Don't be too surprised when you hear this.
It's... the lakeside at Stella Marquis!"
Celica: "Stella Marquis...?"
Maki: "That's right! Where Zigrim's president, Nell Horem,
has his villa.
Of course, that villa's our likeliest candidate."
Arthur: "Just as Garyud said,
he seems to have been someone we needed to watch out for."
Clovis: "But why have you suddenly decided to help?"
Maki: "If this is true, it'll be a huge scoop.
I can't pass up a chance like this!"
Touya: "...So that's what it comes down to.
Well, thanks for helping, anyway."
Ai: "That information had better be reliable."
Maki: "Of course it is!
What would I gain by lying?"
Clovis: "True enough."
Celica: "Anyway, it's worth going there to check.
Captain, may we?"
Roa: "Yes!"
Baren: "...Course set: Stella Marquis.
Liebhofen, move out!"
Kasumi: "Um, Maki..."
Maki: "What?"
Fain: "C-Could you let go of my mouf now...?"
Horem: "Welcome, Ymir Eal Clasio."
Ymir: "...Nell Horem..."
Horem: "To have the Chief First-Class Scholar of the Holy Alchemical Society
remember my name is the greatest honor."
Ymir: "Are you, the president of Zigrim,
saying you hired mercenaries to attack the Holy Land?!
If you do something like that..."
Horem: "Public opinion would turn against me.
But there's no evidence anywhere.
And no one knows where you are..."
Ymir: "...What exactly is your goal?"
Horem: "Please don't be so wary.
I'm only trying to be of some use
to this world."
Ymir: "What do you mean?"
Horem: "As you know, in our Zigrim,
the military has a powerful voice and even attends
Parliament as if it owned the place.
General Growster, who heads that military,
has joined forces with ≪Ze=Ode≫ and is seeking dominion
through force.
As a person of the world of Agarthia, I cannot condone ≪Ze=Ode≫'s
activities."
Ymir: "I've certainly heard that such information exists.
But it seems a little different from what we've learned."
Horem: "You're free to believe me or not.
I'm merely telling you what I know.
Naturally, that's what my actions are based on.
Now, where was I...? Oh, yes.
For the future of this world, I made up my mind.
I would reform this age so full of deceit.
The people do nothing but assert their rights and shirk their duties.
Without someone to light their way, they soon go astray,
fools that they are."
Ymir: "...And so you're saying you'll guide them?"
Horem: "Of course not. I merely intend
to offer my assistance.
To the person who will light the world's way and guide it."
Ymir: "A person... to guide it...?"
Horem: "That person... is Ymir Eal Clasio.
You."
